messages:
maria-g: Hey team — planning to roll a narrow INT4 precision profile (quant_profile: int4-compact) for model-api v2 in eu-west1 tomorrow 10:00 UTC. Targeting 3% traffic (only signups flow). Any blockers? cc @aj @leo

aj: Quick Q — do we have automatic fallback to fp16/int8 on quality or latency thresholds? what's the flag name?

maria-g: Yes fallback exists. Flag: `feature.quantization.model_v2.eu.int4` will route to int8 on SLO breach. We need to confirm thresholds.

leo: I'm +1 but want to see evals on the 20 sample prompts we used last time. Also add a regression alert to the quality eval job.

sophia: Checklist: 1) canary audience slice (3%) set to `audience.signup_eu_v1` 2) Alerting: p95 latency +20% OR token cost drop >30% (for too-aggressive quant) OR hallucination increase +1.5% 3) Rollback cmd

sophia: Rollback (one-liner):
```
redwoodctl flags set feature.quantization.model_v2.eu.int4 false --env prod --region eu-west1
```

maria-g: Perf/QA thresholds I'm proposing: p50 latency increase <=10ms, p95 <=50ms, quality regression <=0.5% (F1 on QA set). If any hit, we rollback. Thoughts?

aj: Sounds reasonable. PR is #4721 — I left a comment about better logging around KV cache warmup. Please link once merged.

leo: Can we also watch `rerank_accuracy` and `response_truncations`? INT4 sometimes adds truncation anomalies.

deploy-bot: feature flag toggle scheduled — feature.quantization.model_v2.eu.int4 will flip at 2023-05-01T10:00:00Z (CI passed) :white_check_mark: https://ci.redwood/4721

maria-g: Thanks — I'll attach the eval artifacts and the smoke test script.

sophia: Smoke test (run after flip):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v2/generate -d '{"prompt":"smoke prompt"}' -H 'x-region: eu-west1'
# validate tokens, latency, and checksum against baseline
```

aj: Ping me when it's live, I'll watch metrics (p95, errors, embeddings drift). Also I can flip audience to 1% if anything odd.

ops-bot: Heads up: capacity booking for eu-west1 peak at 09:30-11:30 UTC, might limit immediate autoscale for new kernels.

leo: I'll queue up the 20 prompts as a canary test and run nightly evals post-flip. :eyes: 

maria-g: great — thanks. If no additional objections I'll proceed to merge PR and schedule toggle. :thumbsup:

aj: +1

leo: +1

sophia: +1

maria-g: (after flip) — flag flipped, monitoring now. reports in #monitoring.

deploy-bot: flag flipped — feature.quantization.model_v2.eu.int4 = true (rollout: 3%) :rocket:

maria-g: Initial check — p50 +4ms, p95 +18ms, no errors spike. continuing to monitor.

leo: quality compare job shows 0.12% drop on micro-F1 so far. within threshold.

aj: keeping eyes on rate of KF retries; nothing abnormal yet. :ok_hand:

sophia: I'll leave the regression alert on for 48h and then we can widen audience if stable.
